subject: NATIONAL-OF function
notes: Verdict SUSTAINED at CONFORMS - attacked at the boundaries the prior pass did not reach, and it held there. Citation re-validated (`cite.py --check 15.66.4 "The length of the returned value is the number of character positions of usage national"` -> OK §15.66.4 4)). `Repertoire` appends exactly one output character per input character and under D-N1 one .NET UTF-16 char IS one national character position, so the returned length is the argument's character count. BOUNDARIES I ADDED: a RUNTIME-VARIABLE length (a DYNAMIC LENGTH argument, the shape `KnownWidth` cannot type statically) and a WIDE picture both give the right length, and the result ref-modifies correctly - so the rule does not depend on a compile-time width being known. The rule is also robust to the RV-15.66.4-1 domain question in a way rules 2 and 3 are not: under any 1:1 correspondence, and under substitution too (one substitution character occupies one national position), the count is unchanged, so this row does not inherit their contingency. RESIDUAL, recorded and not counted against the verdict because it is the same single root already charged to AR-15.66.3-1 / RV-15.66.4-1 rather than a distinct r4 defect: for a figurative-constant or ALL-literal argument-1 there is no returned value at all, hence no length. TEST-REF RETAINED and re-verified as qualifying: tests/conformance/2002/national_intrinsics.cob is spec-derived (its header cites §15.66.4 r4; it is not a NIST golden, not a characterization case, not a *MatchesLegacy/*MatchesGnuCobol method), is registered in tests/conformance/2002/manifest.json, and its golden .out pins `LEN-N=03` for a PIC X(3) argument. EVIDENCE: REFNOF13 (exit 0): `01 DL PIC X DYNAMIC LENGTH` holding "ABCDEFG" -> `FUNCTION LENGTH(FUNCTION NATIONAL-OF(DL))` = DYNLEN=0007; `01 BIG PIC X(300)` -> BIGLEN=0300, and the value stored into `01 NB PIC N(300)` reads back RCVLEN=0300. REFNOF08: `MOVE FUNCTION NATIONAL-OF(A1)(2:3) TO N1` over PIC X(5) "ABCDE" -> RM=[BCD      ], so the result behaves as a 5-position national item under §8.4.3.3.3 SR2. REFNOF06: `FUNCTION LENGTH(FUNCTION NATIONAL-OF(AX))` over a PIC X(3) containing U+4E16 -> 3, i.e. the count is unaffected by a non-Latin-1 code unit. The prior pass's checks re-confirmed: `MOVE FUNCTION NATIONAL-OF(A1) TO <PIC X(9)>` is rejected `error COBOL0819: ... MOVE of a national sending operand to an alphabetic, alphanumeric, or alphanumeric-edited receiver is invalid (ISO §14.9.25.3 SR10 ...)`, so the result is genuinely category national. Golden read directly: tests/conformance/2002/national_intrinsics.out contains `LEN-N=03`. || editions 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): the NATIONAL-OF function exists from 2002 (IntrinsicCatalog.cs, the COBOL1502 edition window).
